name: rluwa-ts
description: An unofficial TypeScript wrapper for the rluwa API
author: gdr

scripts.clean-build: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.test:ast: npm run build && node dist/scripts/test.js ast
scripts.test:bytecode: npm run build && node dist/scripts/test.js bytecode
scripts.test:format: npm run build && node dist/scripts/test.js format
scripts.test:run: npm run build && node dist/scripts/test.js run
scripts.test:sse: npm run build && node dist/scripts/test.js sse
scripts.test:session: npm run build && node dist/scripts/test.js session
scripts.test:stream-session: npm run build && node dist/scripts/test.js stream-session
scripts.test:callbacks: npm run build && node dist/scripts/test.js callbacks
